title: DoD officials advise against disclosure

tellings.quote: I've spoken with some very respectable high-level people in in the in the Department of Defense and some of those in which you know. and the advice has always been people it's it's people will not see what you see.

plain: High-ranking people in the Department of Defense, the US military's headquarters, have told him not to go public with what he knows, says Dave Rossi, a man who says aliens taught him advanced physics. Rossi tells it as advice given to him directly. He says their reasoning has always been that "people will not see what you see".
